Package com.nexuslink.protocol.snmp

Class OidRegistry

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.snmp.OidRegistry
public final class OidRegistry extends Object
A small bundled registry that resolves numeric SNMP object identifiers to symbolic MIB names and back. It ships the SNMPv2-MIB system group and the interfaces / ifTable basics so the browser can show sysDescr.0 instead of 1.3.6.1.2.1.1.1.0.

Everything here is pure and side-effect free, so it is fully unit-testable offline (no live agent). nameFor(java.lang.String) does a longest-prefix match and keeps the trailing instance suffix (1.3.6.1.2.1.1.1.0 ⇒ sysDescr.0); an unknown OID is returned as its plain dotted form. oidFor(java.lang.String) is the inverse and understands an instance suffix (sysName.0 ⇒ 1.3.6.1.2.1.1.5.0).

  • Method Details

    • nameFor

      public static String nameFor(String oid)
      Resolves oid to a symbolic name using a longest-prefix match, appending any trailing instance components (e.g. 1.3.6.1.2.1.1.1.0 ⇒ sysDescr.0). An OID with no known prefix is returned as its plain dotted form (without a leading dot); null/blank input yields null.

    • oidFor

      public static Optional<String> oidFor(String name)
      Resolves a symbolic name back to its numeric OID, honouring an instance suffix (sysName.0 ⇒ 1.3.6.1.2.1.1.5.0, ifDescr.2 ⇒ 1.3.6.1.2.1.2.2.1.2.2). Returns empty when the symbolic part is unknown.

    • isKnown

      True when oid (or one of its prefixes) is a registered, named object.
